summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a heavily obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts the bun binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it to run the sibling file math_init.js during npm install. math_init.js is a ~727KB '// @bun @bun-cjs' compiled bundle with string-array rotation obfuscation (rotation dispatcher WV8StW over a >1000-element mixed array n7gIxM, hex-mangled identifiers) whose contents cannot be inspected as JavaScript source. The package is presented as a Vue webform UI library and has no advertised need for a second language runtime at install time. The combination — preinstall-triggered alternate-runtime fetch used specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated bundle on the installer's host — is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern that evades Node-based install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
